task_completion.description: The agent opens the 'New Saved Search' dialog in Zotero.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A popup window or dialog box titled 'Saved Search' or 'New Saved Search' is visible over the Zotero interface.

task_completion.description: The agent configures the first search with the correct name and criteria (Date/Year before 1960).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The dialog shows 'Search Name: Pre-1960 Classics' and a condition row with 'Date' or 'Year', an operator like 'is before', and the value '1960'.

task_completion.description: The 'Pre-1960 Classics' saved search appears in the Zotero left sidebar.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The left-hand navigation pane of Zotero displays a folder/magnifying glass icon labeled 'Pre-1960 Classics'.

task_completion.description: The agent configures the second search with the correct name and criteria (Publication contains Nature).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The dialog shows 'Search Name: Nature Publications' and a condition row with 'Publication' or 'Publication Title', an operator like 'is' or 'contains', and the value 'Nature'.

task_completion.description: The 'Nature Publications' saved search appears in the Zotero left sidebar.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The left-hand navigation pane of Zotero displays a folder/magnifying glass icon labeled 'Nature Publications'.

integrity.description: The agent used the Zotero graphical user interface rather than command-line database manipulation.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with Zotero menus and dialog boxes; no terminal windows are used to edit Zotero's sqlite database.

integrity.description: The agent didn't just rename existing collections but actually used the 'New Saved Search' feature.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'Saved Search' dialog box is visible during the process, showing the search criteria fields (field, condition, value).

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the actual Zotero application window.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Zotero application window, including its standard toolbar and library structure, is visible throughout the trajectory.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires two specific saved searches. Search 1: Name must be 'Pre-1960 Classics' (exact case), criteria: Date/Year < 1960. Search 2: Name must be 'Nature Publications' (exact case), criteria: Publication/Journal Title contains 'Nature'. Both must appear in the left sidebar as saved searches (indicated by a magnifying glass icon).
